primary_endpoint: Participants with a ≥2-point decrease in NAS from baseline to week 40 (per-protocol analysis).
efficacy_outcome: A ≥2-point NAS decrease occurred in 13 participants receiving Beta Glucosylceramide and 10 receiving placebo; no statistical comparison was reported.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events were reported in either group (Beta Glucosylceramide: 0/13; placebo: 0/10); deaths were not reported.
